messages:
Maya (CS Lead): Quick: assembling a 1-page "go-live health blitz" for customers — short checklist + tiny tech notes on caching, batching, streaming, and renewal-risk flags. Want a review.

Liam (Eng): Love the name. Suggest different defaults for conservative pilots: batch window 60ms or 10 reqs, token budget starter 4k/day/seat.

Maya (CS Lead): Draft customer checklist (1 pager):
- Confirm token cap & SLA (suggest 4k tokens/day/seat baseline).
- Enable route cache (TTL=45s) with key pattern tenant|route|prompt_prefix.
- Turn on streaming for progressive UX on search and chat flows.
- Set client batch window = 60ms or max 10 requests.

Priya (SRE): Warm pool note: start with 3 warm workers per 15 active tenants; add 0-25s startup jitter. Share a simple probe snippet:
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 12
  periodSeconds: 6
  failureThreshold: 3

Liam (Eng): Server-side caps for low-latency pilots: prefer max 32 requests or 128 tokens per batch. Pseudo SDK batching:
batcher.add(req)
setTimeout(() => batcher.flush(), 60)
if (batch.length >= 10) batcher.flush()

Jon (PM): Renewal-risk signals to surface in telemetry:
- Usage dip: 7d MAU down >=35% -> CS outreach + re-engagement play.
- Latency regression: sustained p95 > 1.5x baseline for 48h -> SRE investigation + enable streaming fallback.
- Error spike: error rate >0.9% with ticket -> bridgecall + prioritized remediation.
Actions: prefill top N prompts, increase warm pool briefly, temporary model downgrade.

Maya (CS Lead): Can we share this directly with customers? Ops: which lines are internal-only?

ops-bot: Runbook created: cs/go-live-health-blitz-v1 (internal).

Priya (SRE): All customer bullets OK except exact warm pool counts — keep as ranges in public doc (e.g., 2–4 per 10–20 tenants).

Maya (CS Lead): Noted. I'll publish a customer-facing 1-pager with softer language and keep precise sizing for the internal checklist. Dropping final copy in #cs-docs later today. :thumbsup:
